[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Arts Major in International Relations with Departmental Honors","groupId":"e049bb95-0b8d-4f53-b3f5-019499e36cc7","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and major/program grade point average of 3.5 in order to earn the Bachelor of Arts degree in international relations with departmental honors.

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include:

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit.

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements

","groupId":"d8808046-4b5a-44ce-a662-0194a8e0ca67","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"65c39bb8-d750-46f6-8882-0194a8e1a0ea","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note:  Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"ed212246-5048-44e8-9dee-0194a8e1a0eb","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"a545e3ee-4fa4-4b9d-accc-0194a8e2c38e","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) Competence in a Modern Foreign Language at the level of 4th semester college course or equivalent (typically demonstrated through LANG 025)

2) The semester abroad must be in a program approved by the advisor as

appropriate to the major.

3) The internship chosen for the class must be approved by the advisor as

appropriate to the major.

4) Additional classes focused on historical and domestic cultural diversity may be approved by your advisor

5) Select four upper division electives from the list in Section 5, including at least one ANTH and one POLS.

6) At least two out of the four courses must be taken at Pacific.
